title: Travis Hunter now has two games with a catch and an interception. Deion Sanders had nine.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Travis Hunter now has two games with a catch and an interception. Deion Sanders had nine.
sources.description: Jaguars cornerback Travis Hunter intercepted a pass on Sunday against the Titans, and doing his part-time job as a wide receiver, he also caught two passes.
